resources.string: Bopomofo half-keyboard and English input, using the MokyaInput Engine of the MokyaLora feature phone.
Mokya IME is not enabled yet.
Mokya IME is enabled but not the current keyboard.
Mokya IME is the current keyboard.

On-screen keyboard: each key carries two Bopomofo symbols (ㄞㄢㄦ has three). Tap a key to match any of them; slide left or right on it to pick the left or right symbol, or hold it for the first (ㄢ on ㄞㄢㄦ). MODE switches 中 / EN / ABC; on ，SYM slide left for 、 or right for ：, and hold it for a page of symbols and digits, which types one and goes back; on 。？！ slide left for 。, right for ！, hold for ？. Tap a candidate to enter it; swipe the row or tap ▲ to see them all; OK enters the highlighted one, and shows the field\'s action when nothing is pending. ABC is a QWERTY keyboard with numbers.

Hardware keyboard: 中 mode uses the standard Zhuyin (Dachen) layout and Enter commits; EN mode predicts words; ABC types directly. Ctrl+Space switches modes. Shift types capitals and full-width punctuation (，。？：！).
